title: The Classified Hubble Photo That Showed a 'Face' in the Orion Nebula
hook: A declassified NASA image reveals a perfectly symmetrical structure that looks like a cosmic face staring back at Earth—and astronomers have no explanation for what created it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines conspiracy theory fuel with real NASA imagery, triggering the 'hidden truth' reflex and UFO-adjacent curiosity.
